summary: Proposal updated with Fallback Design section covering: auto-fallback chain for parent orchestrator, subagent fallbackModels, config in user settings ~/.pi/agent/settings.json, cross-provider guard with user approval, reset-time awareness from Codex rate-limit headers, and deterministic receipt trail.

Requirements phase ready for human approval: 16 requirements (REQ-01 to REQ-16), 7 scenarios (SCN-01 to SCN-07), deterministic validation passed, serial fallback audit PASS. Covers model routing, subagent routing, fallback design with auto-fallback chain, cross-provider guard, config surface, escalation guards.

Design updated per user feedback: setup workflow now must use a deterministic settings writer script that validates proposed config with JSON Schema and validates provider/model IDs against Pi available models. Workflow warns when fallbacks are missing and recommends available subscription/free models such as opencode/big-pickle as final fallback for suitable agents, with privacy/quality caveats for redactor. Added C008 Deterministic Settings Writer. Validation passed 0 errors/warnings.

Plan re-finalized after making live smoke test a required final validation gate. The gate must use cheap/free model paths such as opencode/big-pickle when available, validate real model selection plus fallback/error handling, and stop for user approval or blocked validation if no cheap/free model exists.

P0 ADR and Policy Baseline complete: ADR-0010 created under docs/adr for user-configurable model routing and deterministic fallback setup. Topic ADR metadata synced. ADR validation and topic JSONL validation passed.

P1 deterministic model config script complete and audited PASS. Script validates proposed config, available models, thinking levels, modality for primary and fallback models, no xhigh defaults, no-fallback warnings including explicit empty fallbackModels, free/subscription fallback recommendations, preview/apply, preservation of unrelated settings, and atomic writes. Tests now cover 9 cases and check:scripts passes.

P2 interactive setup skill complete and audited PASS. Skill documents missing/partial config detection, provider menu, role recommendations, main orchestrator recommendation, no-fallback warnings, opencode/free fallback suggestions, deterministic writer preview/apply, confirmation, safety rules, and no free-form settings edits. Docs tests strengthened and pass.

P3 fallback runtime integration complete and audited PASS. Added model fallback classifier/executor utilities with tests for Codex usage-limit reset headers, model unavailable, provider transient, same-provider auto fallback, cross-provider approval/pre-approval, declined approval, exhausted chains, and non-retryable no-retry behavior. 17 model_config tests and check:scripts pass.

P4 documentation complete and audited PASS. README documents model routing setup, safe proposal JSON example, deterministic model_config.ts preview/apply, JSON Schema and available-model validation, role matrix, no-xhigh policy, cross-provider approval, no-fallback/free fallback guidance, redactor caveat, and parent hot-swap limitation. Docs tests and formatting checks pass.

P5 final validation complete. Live smoke passed after opencode/big-pickle 429 and user-approved GPT-5.4 low fallback; openai-codex/gpt-5.4:low returned MODEL_SMOKE_OK. Deterministic validation passed: model_config tests, workflow docs tests, check:scripts, typecheck, targeted eslint for model_config files, formatting checks, topic validation, planning graph validation, and ADR validation. Full npm run lint:ts remains red on unrelated dashboard lint; fallback receipt documents targeted feature lint pass and residual risk.

Model optimization implementation complete. P0-P5 complete with ADR-0010, deterministic settings writer, interactive model-config skill, fallback runtime helpers, README/docs/tests, live smoke evidence, final audit PASS, and topic/graph validation. Residual risk: full npm run lint:ts remains red for unrelated dashboard files outside feature scope; targeted feature lint passed and fallback receipt recorded.

Strict skill-language validation has zero findings for model-config skill. Rebased TypeScript test drift in tests/cartographer_tools.test.ts was fixed to match CompactOptions.onComplete(result). Focused validation passed for check:scripts, strict skill language, typecheck, targeted eslint, model_config tests, cartographer_tools tests, topic validation, and planning graph validation.
